_comment: The M1 candidates (SPEC §2). Revisions resolved 2026-09-20; re-resolve with ./deploy/vllm/vllm.sh resolve <repo> and find out what changed before following a move.

candidates.name: qwen36-35b-a3b-nvfp4
candidates.notes: Candidate A. The only one with an official vLLM recipe validated on the RTX 5090. Multimodal, run text-only: FarmHub has no multimodal path and the vision tower's memory is memory the KV cache needs. Watch the kernel line: NVFP4 MoE on sm_120 may fall back to Marlin W4A16.

candidates.name: qwen3-30b-a3b-2507-awq
candidates.notes: Candidate B. No vendor NVFP4 build of Instruct-2507 exists, so 4-bit is the realistic path for the model SPEC originally chose.

candidates.name: mistral-small-32-24b-awq
candidates.notes: Fallback (SPEC §2). Community AWQ build; no official one exists. Revision resolved 2026-09-20.
